title: Uncle Mickey and General Exon at Air Materiel Command
place_text: Air Materiel Command, Wright Field, Ohio

tellings.quote: my uncle Mickey and General Exxon were worked at the air material command in 47.

plain: In 1947, the writer Whitley Strieber's uncle, whom he calls Uncle Mickey, and an Air Force general named Arthur Exon both worked at Air Materiel Command, the Air Force's supply and research headquarters at Wright Field in Ohio. Strieber tells this to Michels as family knowledge. He raises it because it ties his own relatives to the base where, in UFO lore, crash material from that year was said to have gone.
